limits: The desktop did not switch a NixOS generation; its scoped runtime unit and credentials are lost on reboot, and a later desktop activation already removed its /run secrets while the service kept running. Aspen3 switched through Clan on 2026-09-26 as a shared-pool client without its own service or vars.

The earlier isolated API/OMP smoke ran locally. Live britton-desktop GPT-5.5 generation succeeded. Aspen3 reaches the desktop pool through its tunnel, but its provider key lookup fails until the desktop proxy key is installed again, so no Aspen3 inference is claimed.
Each service machine requires fresh browser device authorization after deployment. Existing OMP OAuth refresh tokens must not be copied.

The isolated empty-pool smoke had no upstream generation. The later three-account pool generated GPT-5.5 successfully via its healthy account; in-flight provider-error failover and the other advertised models were not exercised.
Existing default model choices, sessions and research extension files were not changed.
The local monitor socket intentionally exposes account labels and usage to local users, following upstream behavior.
